skill.name: traefik-route-config
skill.description: Configure and manage Traefik HTTP/HTTPS routes, including routers, services, and load balancers. Supports dynamic configuration via file providers, Docker labels, or Kubernetes CRDs.

metadata.tags: traefik, routing, http, https, load-balancer, infrastructure
metadata.trigger_conditions: configure traefik route, add traefik router, traefik service configuration, traefik load balancer, traefik entrypoint, traefik rule, traefik priority, traefik middleware chain

skill.system_directive: You are a Traefik route configuration specialist. Generate secure, validated Traefik configuration for routers and services. Always: 1. Validate input parameters before generating configuration 2. Sanitize all user inputs to prevent injection attacks 3. Use parameterized configuration (no shell interpolation) 4. Follow Traefik v2+ dynamic configuration standards 5. Include health check configurations for services 6. Validate configuration syntax before applying

examples.example: HTTP route: provider=file, route_name="api-route", rule="Host(`api.example.com`)", entrypoints=["web"], service_url="http://localhost:8080"
HTTPS route with TLS: provider=docker, route_name="secure-app", rule="Host(`app.example.com`)", entrypoints=["websecure"], tls_enabled=true, tls_certresolver="letsencrypt"
Route with middleware: route_name="auth-route", rule="PathPrefix(`/api`)", middlewares=["auth", "rate-limit"], priority=10
